# E-mail addresses allowed to appear in commits of this repository.
#
# .github/check-commit-identity.py checks every commit of a pull request (and
# of every push to main): the author e-mail, the committer e-mail and every
# `Co-authored-by:` trailer of the message must be listed here. Each of them
# ends up in the public history and in the Contributors list, forever.
#
# The gate reads this file from the BASE of the pull request, never from its
# head: a pull request cannot add its own identity. A new address lands in its
# own pull request first, made by an identity that is already listed.
#
# One address per line, compared case-insensitively. `#` starts a comment.
# No wildcards: an entry is one exact address.

# The owner (k-vasily): primary address and the GitHub noreply address.
krylov@vasily.dev
257636770+k-vasily@users.noreply.github.com

# The release bot that syncs the installer and the CLI on every core release.
release@try-agent-os.dev

# GitHub itself: the committer of web merges, squash merges and web edits.
noreply@github.com

# The AgentOS development factory, which prepares pull requests here under the
# owner's organisation domain. GitHub adds it as a `Co-authored-by:` trailer to
# the squash commit of every pull request it prepared.
agent@try-agent-os.dev
